text:
jasper lee: hey everyone! i'm jasper (they/them) and i started today on Growth Eng. moved here from portland. quick question — does anyone bike to the office? curious about bike storage, showers, and nearby repair shops. also, would anyone be down for a casual lunchtime ‘city loop’ ride sometime this week? :)

onboarding-bot: Welcome to Redwood, jasper! I've noted your new-hire onboarding checklist. Facilities will follow up about bike storage access.

morgan: welcome jasper! i bike from soma every day — racks behind the 4th-floor loading dock, showers in the locker room. we usually do a 20–30 min loop at 12:30. ping @morgan if you want to join.

devlin: hey hey, welcome! there's a bike co-op on 3rd St that does repairs and 10% off for employees. we keep a pump + spare tube by the mailroom (labelled 'community kit').

lucy: fyi: secure indoor rack spots are limited. Facilities runs a waitlist/lottery each quarter. tagging them here. :)

facilities: @lucy @morgan thanks — jasper, i've added you to the bike-locker waitlist and requested shower access. can you DM your badge number so we can enable it?

rachel: welcome jasper :wave: coffee at 10am in the kitchen? the cycling group normally meets after. i'll intro you.

jasper lee: amazing, thanks all! DMing badge number now. 10am coffee works great. curious — who prefers gravel vs road? i'm more gravel but happy to follow.

tony: gravel > road :bike: but i'm down for any pace. also +1 on the pump in the mailroom.

morgan: gravel squad assembled :metal: see you at coffee. if anyone wants a short map, i've got a gpx of our loop — i can drop it in #devex-resources.

jasper lee: perfect — appreciate it. excited to be here! :thumbsup:

(on a separate note, a tiny thread to facilities about lockers happened over DM after this.)
